# China Daily

> > China Daily is China's leading English-language news portal, connecting China to the world through comprehensive coverage of sports, international affairs, military news, and multimedia content.

China Daily (Chinadaily.com.cn) provides extensive coverage of global and Chinese news, with particular strength in sports journalism covering the NBA, FIFA, Olympics, and tennis championships. The site features photo galleries, special coverage sections, and bilingual content serving international audiences interested in China-related news and cross-strait affairs.

## Key Topics

- China Daily
- International sports coverage
- NBA and basketball
- FIFA and football
- Olympic Games
- Cross-strait relations
- Photo journalism
- Military affairs
- Global news
- Special coverage reports
- Tennis championships
- China sports
- International curiosities
- Multimedia content

## Sports Coverage

- [Sports top news - Sports - Chinadaily.com.cn](http://www.chinadaily.com.cn/sports/top_news.html): Top sports news headlines covering FIFA, NBA, and international events
- [Olympic Games - chinadaily.com.cn](http://www.chinadaily.com.cn/sports/Olympic-Games.html): Olympic Games coverage with international sports news and updates
- [Wimbledon Championships - chinadaily.com.cn](http://www.chinadaily.com.cn/sports/Wimbledon-Championships.html): Wimbledon Championships tennis coverage and news
- [Special Coverage](http://www.chinadaily.com.cn/sports/sports_yaoming_beyond.html): Yao Ming special coverage on basketball and China sports
- [Sports hot talks and discussions](http://www.chinadaily.com.cn/sports/hottalks.html): Sports hot talks and discussions navigation page

## Photo Galleries

- [Photo Gallery of China Daily Website - Connecting China Connecting the World](http://www.chinadaily.com.cn/photo/08index.html): 2008 photo archive featuring China, sports, entertainment, and world news
- [精彩热图 - 中文国际](http://www.chinadaily.com.cn/hqbl/rttj_hqbl.html): Featured international news photos and multimedia content

## Military and Cross-Strait Affairs

- [中国日报网 - 军事台海频道](http://www.chinadaily.com.cn/hqjs/node_1023203.htm): Taiwan Strait military affairs and cross-strait defense news channel

## International News and Blogs

- [环球博客](http://www.chinadaily.com.cn/hqph/zxjl_hqph.html): Global blog community forum and discussion board
- [环球博客 - Rankings and Records](http://www.chinadaily.com.cn/hqph/tjsy_hqph.html): Global news rankings, world records, and international curiosities
- [环球幽默](http://www.chinadaily.com.cn/hqym/jctj_hqym.html): Global humor featuring international curiosities and human interest stories
- [环球博客 - Entertainment](http://www.chinadaily.com.cn/hqbk/ylbk.html): Entertainment blog navigation page in Chinese
